definitions.gloss: at most; at the most; no more than
definitions.explanation: Sets an upper limit on a quantity or degree. Indicates the maximum possible amount.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くとも{十人|じゅうにん}だろう。
examples.english: It's probably ten people at most.

examples.japanese: {費用|ひよう}は{多|おお}くとも{五万円|ごまんえん}で{済|す}む。
examples.english: The cost will come to 50,000 yen at most.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くとも{三日|みっか}あれば{終|お}わるはずだ。
examples.english: It should be finished in three days at most.

notes:
Sets an upper limit on a quantity. Formed from {多|おお}い (many) in its く form + とも (even if). Literally "even if many."

USAGE:
Placed before the quantity being limited. More formal and written than {多|おお}くても, which is the everyday spoken equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {多|おお}くとも + number: at most [number]
- {多|おお}くとも + time: at most [time period]

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多|おお}くても: at most (casual, spoken)
- せいぜい: at most (casual, sometimes dismissive)
- {最大|さいだい}で: at maximum (factual)

OPPOSITE:
- {少|すく}なくとも: at least (sets a lower limit)
